newsitem.title: UK: European jet premiums slip slightly, demand modest.
newsitem.headline: European jet premiums slip slightly, demand modest.

text.p: NWE jet premiums were knocked a touch lower on Tuesday but outright prices held firm, bouyed by stronger IPE gas oil futures.
March IPE gas oil closed $2 a tonne higher at $168.75.
Jet barge premiums were pegged around March IPE gas oil +$22-23 although larger parcels of 10,000 tonnes or so could probably attract a discount of $2 or so, traders said.
Cargo business was very slow and premiums were notionally $1 lower at March IPE +$24 cif NWE.
"There's too little going on, no cif talk because there is a lack of buying interest," said one trader.
In Mediterranen jet premiums continue to be sharply lower than in NWE. Dealers said EU grade material was heard offered at March IPE +$8 with buyers looking closer to +$6.
